description: Local read-only claims/no-go dashboard configuration. It defines the bounded claim baseline, key documents for deterministic overclaim scanning and safe report destinations without mutating claims or gates.

claims_baseline.title: Production-ready-local
notes: Allowed only inside the local-first scope and only while POST-H-025 no-go gates remain safe.

claims_baseline.title: Audit-friendly
claims_baseline.scope: internal technical audit evidence, not compliance certification
notes: Conditioned claim from POST-H-031-D backlog baseline; it must not be represented as compliance certification.

claims_baseline.title: Enterprise-ready
claims_baseline.reason: Enterprise readiness remains blocked until future approved backlog/ADR implements enterprise deployment controls.

claims_baseline.title: Remote-ready
claims_baseline.reason: Remote execution and remote readiness remain disabled/design-only.

claims_baseline.title: Compliance-certified
claims_baseline.reason: Compliance mapping is non-certifying and no external audit/legal certification is claimed.

claims_baseline.title: SaaS-ready
claims_baseline.reason: SaaS readiness is not declared; DevPilot remains local-first.

notes: POST-H-031-D is an operator dashboard over existing claims/no-go evidence; it does not create a new readiness declaration.
The audit-friendly baseline is bounded to internal evidence/audit usability and is not a compliance-certified claim.
